g.title: layerA
g.text: Hard-wired safety relays (dual channel, force-guided contacts)
Doors, emergency stop, grounding. Cuts mains to the
HV supplies and the platform. No software, no

g.title: layerB
g.text: PLC with fail-safe wiring (energize to run)
Cooling, vacuum, temperatures. Removes the permits.
Latches, needs a manual reset, remembers the first

g.title: layerC
g.text: Reads every input and permit over Ethernet
Shows state, first fault and bypass. Can request a
reset. Never part of the trip path.

g.title: out0
g.text: acts on: AU supplies, platform isolation transformer

g.title: out1
g.text: acts on: AU supplies (external interlock input)

g.title: out2
g.text: acts on: filament heating and discharge supplies

g.title: out3
g.text: acts on: MFC / gas solenoid valve

g.title: in3
g.text: flow switches or Opta flow readout
